blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III on Tuesday set the sitting schedule for former President Rodrigo Duterte’s trial, initially covering the first week of proceedings. During the chamber’s fourth status conference, Presiding Judge Joanna Korner said the schedule for the trial’s first week, Nov. 30 to Dec. 4, would consist of four daily sessions: 10 to 11 a.m., 11:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m., 1:30 to 2:30 p.m., and 3 to 4 p.m. The sessions will be separated by 30-minute breaks, with a one-hour lunch break between the second and third sessions. “We’ve had various recommendations and […]...
